summary: Performs render picking for rows of UV coordinates in a DAT and returns object paths plus optional position, normal, depth, UV, color, alpha, and instance data.

key_params.name: strategy
key_params.note: Update or hold strategy for pick rows

key_params.name: rendertop
key_params.note: Render TOP or Render Pass TOP to pick from

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Input rows need the documented select, u, and v columns for multi-sample picking.
This Cook response is slower than Next Cook because it waits for current render information.
Picked path and data fields depend on render setup, camera, pickable flags, and enabled fetch options.
key_concepts: Samples a 3D render at pick locations and returns surface information from rendered geometry.
Input pick DATs require at least select, u, and v columns.
Render TOP/Render Pass TOP source, pick radius, strategy, and response time control the picking query.
Callbacks can be activated to react to render-pick results, often paired with Multi Touch In DAT.
